description.en:
Plays an HQ event (a staged cut-scene using the models, camera and lights the event has prepared) and waits until it ends: CMND_MAKE_CHILD_HQ_EVENT_SCENE(_sndID + "_<LG>", _cutNum, _endWhiteFade), then it suspends until CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE is false.
The events create the models between StartSetupHQEventChara and EndSetupHQEventChara, register the map, camera and objects with CMND_HQ_EVENT_INIT and CMND_REG_HDL_HQ_EVENT, and set which map lights are on in each cut with CMND_REG_MAP_LIGHT_HQ_EVENT.
Sound name without the language suffix, e.g. "hqev010100".
true to end on a fade to white.
